newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwaiti gives $10,000 to Jordan soldier's mother.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti gives $10,000 to Jordan soldier's mother.

text.p: A Kuwaiti businessman has donated $10,000 to support the mother of the Jordanian soldier who shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls last week, a newspaper reported on Wednesday.

"Kuwaiti businessman Abdul-Hameed Mansour al-Mazeedi said he had donated $10,000 to the mother of the Jordanian soldier Ahmed Mousa al-Daqamsa who had opened fire on an Israeli bus," al-Rai al-Aam newspaper.
"Mazeedi said...he had taken this initiative when he heard the Jordanian authorities have suspended the salary of the soldier and that he was the sole supporter of his mother," it said.
Daqamsa, shot dead seven teenage Israeli schoolgirls on Thursday on Jordanian territory leased to Israel under a 1994 peace treaty.
